rules.text: Every accuracy figure names the resolved model that produced it, never an alias, and the endpoint it was served from. An alias is not provenance: `primary` moved from a 27B to a 35B MoE on 2026-08-30, and every figure recorded against the name alone became a figure about nothing. A run whose measurement changed under it is withdrawn, not restated.

The fold takes ts_unix and actor as given. What defends the ledger is whoever may append to the file: git in a repository, the household on a shared folder. Neither is canon's, and canon says so rather than pretending to be it. canon guard is the second-order tool, outside the format and outside the ledger it guards.
Every accuracy figure names the model and the endpoint that produced it. A figure whose run predates a change to what it measures is withdrawn, not restated.
Every repository path a narrative document cites must resolve. docs-gate checks it, because a map that is wrong about where things are is worse than no map.

Every repository path a narrative document links to must resolve. docs-gate checks it. Backticked paths in prose are deliberately not checked — most are shorthand rather than citations, and a gate whose false positives outnumber its catches is one people learn to ignore.

zoracite's law is determined within zoracite: a rule, principle or document that points into commonwealth-ai is adapted to zoracite's locality and held here, never bound by reference. commonwealth-ai's published specs stay external as the platform's contract, read and never law, and its process tooling is used, never cited as law.

A guard ships with its remedy: before a check refuses work or hands it to a person, it tries what would clear it, and it counts what it guards against (no progress), not a proxy for it (elapsed time).

A recovered step is its instruction — the masked system message, response_format and the user turn's fixed prefix — and a tolerance in that identity is bounded and shown: two system messages within the instruction bar of the step's representative (decided by the calls, never by their order, and never chained call to call) are one instruction, a variant of the step that its face counts and lists; the bar sits between the drift it must join and the closest real sibling sites it must never merge, both measured. Answers can-957a14f9e6f3 (orders/r13-instruction-tolerance TI-1).

A request's system has parts — a Messages system's text blocks, chat's system and developer turns, a Responses call's instructions — and the instruction bar reads it part by part: two systems are one instruction when they carry the same number of parts and each part is within the bar of the representative's part at its position, the 21-word exact clause read per part; the boundary the pipeline itself declares is never joined away, so a long cached block shared by every site and a short block of each site's own stay as many steps as the sites. Amends can-543cc6dbe11e (orders/r13-claude-onramp CO-2, ACK R13-CO2-L12 = A).

A paid call is a row before it leaves: a hop's ledger row is committed sent in the decision that admits it, before the request goes to the port, and the call's observation settles it once, forward only (ok, error or duplicate). A row a kill leaves sent stays on the ledger, never deleted and never settled by guess: a call that left and whose answer the ledger never held, counted as a call whose cost is unknown, summed as nothing and charged to no line; the resume performs the open intent again under the same idempotency key, at its own attempt. So every call a host was served is a ledger row, and a row no host was served is sent. Applies can-db01aecf833d to the inference port (orders/r13-held-faults HF-2; spec/ONTOLOGY.md L13).

The store is the trace of record: nothing is emitted, measured or shown unless it is a row first; artifact, verdict, ledger row and checkpoint commit in one transaction; a run resumes from the store alone.
